study type: Retrospective Program Evaluation and Framework Development
exposure: Development and implementation of a retrospective theory of change and impact framework
outcome: Theory of change and impact framework
Prioritised metrics toolkit (core impact indicators and process indicators)
cohort: The study involved a review of documents and literature, and consultation with expertise across the Saving Lives at Birth partnership and stakeholders.
finding: The retrospective development of a theory of change and impact framework, complemented by a prioritised metrics toolkit, proved useful for structured reflection on program mechanics and informing subsequent program rounds, despite challenges in identifying a uniform set of metrics.
